title: Fleon-chan
text: “Sakura will sing you a lullaby. Or maybe I’ll tell you one of those fairy tales Naofumi and Motoyasu taught me?”
Ever since she started going out with her Finacée, Sakura-chan has been acting like a Big Sister. Her Father watches her with a warm smile.
“Whichever you prefer, Sakura-chan.”
“Then I guess I’ll tell you a story.”
“Really… Melty-chan and Sakura-chan are just like close sisters, aren’t they?”

My Father said in a gentle tone. That’s right. I wonder why, but seeing them get along so well… it almost makes it look like my Finacée is cheating. Even though you have a Finacée named Filo-tan, you’re still making a move on Sakura-chan. Filo-tan is crying!
“Hehe… You know, I’ve always wanted a Big Sister like Sakura-chan.”
“Huh? But for Melty-chan… I mean, well, with a Big Sister like that…”

My Father cast a sympathetic glance at my Finacée. That’s right. With a Big Sister who’s such a Crimson Swine, there’s no way she could ever build a relationship like the one Sakura-chan has. I see—so to my Finacée, Sakura-chan isn’t a Finacée, but a Big Sister? I see.
“Dad’s so lenient with my older sister… and Mom’s kind but very strict… I know she’s always busy… but I’ve always wanted someone like a Big Sister who’d let me be a little clingy like this…”
“I see. Mel-chan, you can always lean on Sakura, okay?”
Sakura gave the Finacée a tight hug. The Finacée hugged her back, acting all clingy.
“Yeah!”
“Do you think Sakura-chan can be a great Big Sister?”
“I can! Sakura will protect you as your Big Sister, Mel-chan.”
“That’s right. Do your best.”
“Okay!”

With that, the Finacée chatted briefly with Sakura-chan and was about to fall asleep. However, still unable to calm down from the excitement, the Finacée sat up in bed. Then, he gazed off into the distance toward the window.
“Are you worried about Melromarc?”
“Well, yes… but I’d like to talk to the Shield Hero for a bit…”

My fiancée is talking to my Father, looking a bit shy. Since I was told it would get complicated if I joined them, I’m quietly going about my daily routine of making jewelry and sewing. Yuki-chan wants some jewelry, after all.
“What are you going to talk about?”
“Aren’t you going to sleep yet?”
“Just a little longer—I want to talk some more first. What should we talk about?”
“What are you doing tomorrow, big bro? If she has something to look forward to tomorrow, maybe Melty-chan will sleep soundly, don’t you think?”
That’s the kind of conversation we’re having. …I just realized, though—my own plans have been postponed.
“Come to think of it, Father, you weren’t able to buy the new Filolial-sama, were you?”
“Ah… that’s right. Given the circumstances, I ended up standing Ren up on our promise. I wonder if he’s okay with that?”
“Knowing Ren, as long as the loop isn’t active, I don’t think there’ll be a problem.”
“He’s sensitive to rumors, so I hope he’s figured out that we couldn’t make it…”
“You’re such a worrier.”
“It’s just that Motoyasu-kun is way too laid-back.”
“Even so, I still want to buy Filolial-sama. Should we go there in secret next time?”
“Well… I think that would be dangerous. It’d cause trouble for the slave dealer, and in the worst case, there’s a risk that the precious egg could get caught up in a fight, don’t you think?”

Hmm… You’re right about that. If we go to the monster merchant’s place and assassins from the Three Heroes Church show up there—even if we could take them down with a single blow—if we don’t escape properly, there’ll be casualties.
“You’re right… Let’s go once this commotion dies down.”
It’s an option to go undercover and take risks, but either way, we’ll have to reveal ourselves when talking to the Monster Merchant. Either way, we can’t push our luck.
“Are you buying any other Filolials?”
“That’s right. Melty-chan’s dream is to get along with the Filolials, starting with Sakura-chan, right? Once this commotion is over, I plan to get more, so look forward to it.”
“Yeah.”
“You should be grateful!”
“Why are you acting so high and mighty, Spear Hero?”
My Father scratches his cheek, looking a bit flustered by his Finacée’s reaction.
“Motoyasu, you really do love Filolials, don’t you? Come to think of it, do we really not need to retrieve the three Filolials you first raised?”
“You mean Ku, Marin, and Midori? Well, yes. If we look for them, we might find them.”
In the previous playthrough, there were also Filolials with similar colors and abilities. Presumably, those were the ones who became Ku, Marin, and Midori in the future.

I gave them the same names, but I feel like there were differences in their personalities. To be honest, I can’t help but feel they ended up being a bit subdued. However, my Father is making one major misunderstanding.
“Ku, Marin, and Midori are the Filolial-sama I raised early on, but they weren’t my very first ones.”
“Huh? Really? It comes up pretty often in Motoyasu-kun’s stories, so I just assumed that was the case.”
“To be precise, back when I was still chasing pigs, I took a liking to Filo-tan’s appearance, and after getting kicked, I was raising a Filolial-sama… my very first Filolial-sama, I might add.”
That Filolial-sama brings back some very bitter memories. I started telling my Father about what happened back then.
This was after I asked my Father to set Filo-tan free, and then got kicked by Filo-tan, who was furious at my foolish actions.
“Damn it… That bastard Naofumi—is that fat bird really the kind of girl I like?”
My head was completely filled with thoughts of Filo-tan. I absolutely had to have that angel. I let my mind wander with the foolish notion that I wanted her to become a member of my harem.
“Oink.”

Huh? I can only remember the Crimson Swine’s lines in Pig-speak. I think I recall that when we had the national investigators look into that monster, it turned out to be Filolial-sama—or something like that.
“I won’t let Naofumi be the only one to have all the fun! I’ll raise her too!”

A few days after getting slapped by my Big Sister, I bought a female slave, freed her from her slave mark, and said, “There you go! You’re free now!　You’ll join my crew, right?” I was thinking back on that bitter memory at the time. That slave refused my offer and ran away.
My cheek twitched. And then, thanks to Trash and the Crimson Swine’s mediation, I received a… Filolial egg. I registered it with the Monster Mark, and it hatched the very next day.
“Peep!”
“Oh, so this is going to become an angel someday?”
“Peep!”
“I’ve got to give it a name. Let’s see… Alright! I want it to be just like Fleon-chan, so I’ll call it Fleon!”

Fleon-chan is the name of a character from *Demon Realm: The Great Land*, a game I used to love. Just like Filo-tan, she’s a little blonde girl with long blonde hair and angel wings that gleam pure white. I named her that with the hope that she’d grow up to look just like Fleon-chan, who perfectly matched my taste… that’s why I chose that name.

I didn’t have much time before the wave, but I’d heard that monsters level up quickly depending on their level, so I hurried off to grind. Well, since I wasn’t as strong as I am now, I just leveled her up at a hunting spot with decent efficiency. Fleon-chan grew up healthy and strong.
“Gua!”
“Does she really grow this fast in just a few days?”
I was actually surprised at how quickly she was growing. She rapidly matured into the form of a standard Filolial-sama.
“So, is she going to look like Filo-chan, who used to be with Naofumi…? I can’t wait. Hehehe, when that happens, we’ll have all kinds of fun together!”
“Boo!”
“Boo-boo!”
I remember the Crimson Swine and his entourage saying something. I recall thinking something like, “Hmm, something must have upset them—they seem in a bad mood.”
“This is going to liven things up. We haven’t had any new kids join us lately, so this should be a nice change of pace, right? Let’s all have a fun journey together!”

I’m almost ready to get an angel! With that thought in mind, I put Fleon-chan in the Filolial House at Melromarc Castle and went to sleep. Late that night, while I was sleeping, I was awakened by the sound of someone pounding on the door.
“Oink!”
“What’s going on?!”

Then, with a look of urgency on his face, Crimson Swine delivered some tragic news to me. It was… that Fleon-chan’s condition had taken a sudden turn for the worse, and she had died unexpectedly. I rushed over to the Filolial House, only to find that Fleon-chan had already grown cold.
“Oink!”

At that moment, Crimson Swine explained various possible causes—such as how the monsters created by Father seemed different from the Filolials, or how her body hadn’t been able to keep up with her rapid growth. The government officials also reported similar findings after performing an autopsy on Fleon-chan. Ultimately, it was concluded that because Fleon-chan came from such a pure bloodline, she had been born with a weak constitution…

Anyway, I was filled with the feeling that my father had deceived me. However, I knew that if I took it out on him, he’d just mock me, so I couldn’t say a word. That’s precisely why I believed the story that my father was brainwashing Filo-tan, and why I didn’t believe his claim that if he’d raised Filolial-sama, she would have turned into Filo-tan. Everything my father says is a lie—it’s not worth believing…

Later, when Filo-tan encouraged me and I received a Filolial egg from the Monster Merchant, I trembled as that trauma came flooding back. But because I wanted to recapture that warmth, I completed the registration with trembling hands and, with the utmost care, raised them all all the way to Filolial Queen.

Come to think of it, I cried when Ku, Marin, and Midori hatched, and when they became angels, too. It felt like a ray of light had shone upon me in the midst of my loneliness. Well, it was a different kind of light than the one from Filo-tan, mind you.
Because of that trauma, I couldn’t rest easy until I’d seen Filolial-sama grow up and become an angel with my own eyes.
Settings I Had but Never Used, Part 1
